nodes.name: TURBOGRASS - a beautiful grass sway shader -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: A grass sway shader that will tickle you in the ways you never knew you wanted. OpenMW. Works with any groundcover mod. The sway strength and behaviour changes with weather, supports both Wareya and Rafael PBR.

nodes.name: ReAnimation v3 scraps - 3rd person animation pack -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: A semi-slop-automated port of some of the ReAnimation 1st person weapon animation to 3rd person that turned out quite good.

nodes.name: Katars and Knuckles - a complete class of hand to hand weapons -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: 16 Hand-made weapon meshes, a novel monk/rogue styled weapon class fully integrated with the game mechanics (works off of a hand-to-hand skill) as well as with the world, loot and merchants. The screenshot gallery shows only few weapons to

nodes.name: Handy Stylish Quick Access Wheels
nodes.summary: No more hotkey confusion! Hold the weapon stance button to access the weapon wheel and the spell stance button to access the spell wheel. Animated and looks damn stylish. A more convenient and less confusing alternative to numbered hotkeys

nodes.name: Fairer Weapon and Magic Experience Gains for Sane People
nodes.summary: Fairifies experience gains without overhauling them. Casting magica-expensive spells or using slow weapons brings more XP, failing a cast or missing a swing still grants a little as you learn from your mistakes. Using conjured gear grants a

nodes.name: The Combat Juice
nodes.summary: A layer of subtle "oomph" lovingly smeared all over TES III combat. Does not alter any gameplay mechanics - purely a visual and auditory satisfactorium. If you are sure that Morrowind's combat mechanics are trash - try this before looking

nodes.name: Combat Sounds Overhaul Overhauled
nodes.summary: We put an Overhaul inside your overhaul so you can enjoy an overhauled experience of using an overhaul. A kind of -ish port of a Combat part of Character Sound Overhaul. Weapon and overall combat sounds are now dynamic based on the weapon

nodes.name: They Bleed -- immersive blood effects -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: The spoils of war taint your surroundings; your violence now leaves bloodied marks on the environment. Low-HP player/NPCs also leave subtle blood trails.

nodes.name: Max Yari's Script Services
nodes.summary: A shared script library that many of my mods require. Shares the data between different mods reducing the amount of engine requests they do and potentially improving performance.

nodes.name: Animated Lanterns and Signs -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: Procedurally animates surrounding lanterns and guild signs to swing in the wind. Swing strength can be adjusted in settings. Can be easily extended to support any modded objects. As optimised as it can get, virtually 0 performance effect.

nodes.name: Sneak is Good Now. -- Better Stealth -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: An OpenMW mod that makes sneak mechanics playable and fun. Sneak detection is now a visually displayed gradual progress. It loosely follows original sneak detection formulas and respects original systems.

nodes.name: Bizarre Morrowind animation utilities and a humanoid Rig -- Blender 5.1
nodes.summary: Utilities for easy 1st/3rd person animation export and beast animations retargeting (Blender addon). And a AutoRig Pro-based rig with everything you need to start anymating - IK/FK limbs, 1st person camera, 2h weapon grip constraints e.t.c.

nodes.name: Hit Reactions Animated v2 -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: Short, pronounced twitches of humanoid NPCs in response to being hit as well as many new stagger and death animation of a glorious fake-ragdoll kind.

nodes.name: Lua Physics Engine -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: A deranged mod that implements a somewhat simple and naive physics engine in pure lua and exposes a rich interface for developers. Drag and throw items around, get messed for messing with someone's property.

nodes.name: Dynamic Reticle and Oblivion style enemy HP and stamina bars -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: Animated customizable reticle adapts to sneaking, shooting and fades out when weapon is not drawn. With a neat optional oblivion-style enemy HP widget. Everything is adjustable in mod settings.

nodes.name: Dynamic camera - Immersive 1st and 3rd person camera effects and target lock -- OpenMW
nodes.summary: Subtle dynamic camera and first-person viewmodel (hands) inertia. More natural movement and jumping.Target lock with shader effects (bokeh) and a sneak shader (vignette). Immersive cell transition effects (bokeh). Experimental strafe

nodes.name: Stupid-Metal Hitmarker-Mod --- OpenMW
nodes.summary: Hit em good with better visual feedback!

nodes.name: Mercy - Combat AI Overhaul
nodes.summary: An immersive overhaul of in-combat NPC behavior for OpenMW 0.51+. With new voice lines (optional) and animations. Rich on memorable encounters and engaging fights.

nodes.name: Behaviour Tree Lua 2nd Edition
nodes.summary: Pure Lua behaviour tree library. A modder resource.

nodes.name: RETIRED -- One-handed animations and idle fixes
nodes.summary: Rework of 1h weapon movement and idles aiming to look more natural. Also tweaks 1h attacks and unbugs vanilla idles without making the feet slide. Only affects 3rd-person animations.

nodes.name: The Bird Yoinker - Where are all birds going OpenMW fix

nodes.name: Animation Blending - OpenMW
nodes.summary: Smooth transitions between nearly every animation in the game. Moddable. Compatible with EVERYTHING.

nodes.name: ReAnimation v3 - Complete - first-person animation pack
nodes.summary: An immersive reimagining of the TES3: Morrowind 1st-person animations. Punch, slash, chop, shoot and thrust your way through vvardenfell with style!

nodes.name: Dim Glass - Less Irritating Glass Armor and Weapon
nodes.summary: Retexture - Dimmer less acidic color for the glass armor and weapon.
